GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Over-raced in the early and middle stages. Held up rounding the home turn and had difficulty obtaining clear running nearing the 100 metres.
Shifted out rounding the home turn, bumping with SAVEE.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly & Settled Down 7 Lengths on fence, railed to 6 Lengths turning, improved only a half length in Straight # never a factor
Jumped okay & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 4 Lengths rail turning, stuck to fence rounding turn and Made Some Ground along rail in Straight # battled on fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 1100m, brushed the inside running rail & became unbalanced when racing tight to the inside of BEST COFFEE. Approaching the 200m, was disappointed for a narrow run between TREASURER & JUNGLE FEVER.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Went Forward from Outside Settled Down 1/2 Lengths Clear own terms To The Turn led 2 Lengths Straightening Up , Collared x 200m, Weakened to the line - # run ended 200m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted in at the start and bumped. Rdr reported not intention to lead, however after beginning well, rather than be caught wide, allowed mount to stride and settle in a leading position.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, dropped back and Settled Down last 11 Lengths Two Wide , Made Some Ground to 7.5 Lengths Two Wide still last turning, shifted 3 Wide Straightening Up and Made Good Ground in Straight # got too far back

Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths 3 Wide , held together much same to turn then Dropped Out in straight. [Stewards questioned rider re performance. App. jockey stated she pressured it to go forward from the Wide barrier and was forced to race Wide and, with it being first-up, she felt this affected the performance. Post-race vet exam revealed no significant findings.] # always Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three wide without cover. When asked to comment on the performance, rdr stated she pressured her mount to go forward from the wide barrier, however was forced to race wide and with the gelding being first up from a spell today, felt this had an effect on the performance. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abs.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained thus Settled Down 5th Inside 4 Lengths off leader/winner off Inside x 600m held-up Straightening Up 6th, truly Clear x 250m, then run ended 100m - slow post race recovery, # good $$ slow rec.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned as to whether there was an opportunity near 300m to improve between runners, Rdr advised instructed not to present mount too early in straight as the gelding was racing over 1800m for the first time-added on straightening anticipated mount would be taken into the race, however; was of opinion racing surface was better toward inside, elected to shift in passing the 200m. A post-race vet exam revealed a slow recovery. Tnr advised now going for a spell.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained thus Settled Down 9th Inside 7 Lengths off leader/winner last x Turn too much to do , 8th x 300m 6th x 200m 3rd x 100m Closest on line, # Sound eff/finale
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Held up approaching the home turn until approaching the 300m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok went Straight back off the Wide gate balanced up second last fence 9-10 Lengths (1000m), cornered for home sticking to the Inside going to need luck! Squeezed Through 150 & ran on well finishing close up # good from last!
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Held up for clear running round home turn until passing the 200m.
